Corollary
[approximation by constant-speed curves]

Source: petersen:page-0198 ↗ thm:pet-ch5-metric-topology ↗ prop:pet-ch5-arclength-reparametrization

1. ch5:5.3.10For $c\in \Omega _{p,q}$ and $\epsilon >0$ there is a constant-speed $\bar c\in \Omega _{p,q}$ with $L(\bar c)\le (1+\epsilon )L(c)$.
Proof

↗ cor:pet-ch5-regular-curve-approx \sketch In finitely many comparison charts from section 3, smooth polygonal approximations give a regular $\bar c$ with

\[ L_g(\bar c)\le \mu _0L_{g_0}(\bar c)\le \mu _0L_{g_0}(c)\le \frac{\mu _0}{\lambda _0}L_g(c). \]

Shrink the charts so $\mu _0/\lambda _0<1+\epsilon $. Finally apply section 3, which preserves length and makes the regular approximation constant speed.

□
